about: Cases for the label line-break rule (R1-R4) in linebreak.py, stated without a font. Width rule: a wide East Asian character (Unicode East_Asian_Width W or F) counts 2, every other character 1; a line fits when its width is at most `width`. `layout` cases give the text and the lines the rule sets it on; `overwide` lists the items broken under R4. `check` cases give lines already set and the findings expected over their breaks, in order. `forced` cases add the measure of the box drawn round the lines: an R1 break is reported only where the line before it could not take the next line's first word at that measure. A first or last item of a spaced run with more than three words is prose: only the word touching its dot is bound.
